title: Day 1 Thread: Meeting the 'Orbital Architect'
description: 1/ Let's personify Coordination Gravity as the 'Orbital Architect.' It doesn't create chaos; it creates stable orbits. 2/ In a startup, the Architect's pull is weak—teams are asteroids. As you scale, gravity strengthens, demanding clearer paths (orbits) for resources and decisions. 3/ Resistance is futile. Fighting it causes collisions (silos). Embracing it means designing intentional orbits (processes) before the Architect forces messy ones.
